front: In AWS Organizations, teams in several member accounts must launch instances into the subnets of one central VPC. What do you use?
back: Share the subnets with AWS RAM.
extra: AWS RAM shares a subnet with [only AWS accounts in its own organization](../facts/ram.md#ram-share-subnets-only-within-organization), and it [eliminates the need to provision duplicate resources](../facts/ram.md#ram-reduces-overhead-no-duplicate-resources).
